content: Partial support of this work by the Hariri Institute for Computing and Computational Science & Engineering at Boston University (to L.G.) and a Google Faculty Research Award (to M.B. and L.G.) is gratefully acknowledged. Additionally, we would like to thank Daniel Khashabi for his help in running the CogComp-NLP Python API and Mike Thelwal for his help with TensiStrength. We are also grateful to the Stanford NLP group for clarifying some of the questions we had with regards to the Stanford NER tool.
